name: shadow-resonance-no-shadow-below-four-preparation
notes: Shadow Resonance (10rsagp9m8, UMBRA action, reserve 2): "Recover 2, then draw a card. [Tristan Bonus] If your champion has four or more preparation counters on them, summon an Ominous Shadow token." Tristan, Shadowdancer (UMBRA, Tristan lineage) is patched in with 5 damage and 3 preparation counters. Played for real: RecoverChampion(2) takes Damage from 5 to 3, Draw(1) adds a card (hand 8 -> 7 after playing it -> 5 after paying 2 -> 6 after the draw), and with only 3 counters (below the threshold) no token is summoned.

rulesClauses: [Tristan Bonus] With fewer than four preparation counters no Ominous Shadow token is summoned.
